chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Safwan ibn Yahya from Muawiya ibn 'Ammar who said:
"The she-camel is shorn from its right side, then a shoe in which prayer has been performed is hung around its neck."

key_terms.قَدْ صَلَّى فِيهَا: In which prayer has been performed

ai.seo_question: What is the ritual procedure for preparing a sacrificial camel (badanah) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* details the specific preparation of the sacrificial camel (*badanah*), emphasizing the ritual clipping of hair from its right side and adorning it with a shoe previously used in prayer. This practice highlights the concept of *tashrif* (honoring) the animal, linking its physical preparation to spiritual devotion, a tradition preserved within Shia fiqh for Hajj and Umrah sacrifices.
